item.title: Municipal Water Utilities Issue Leak-Indexed Green Bonds Tied to Pipe Sensors
item.description:
MILAN — Three mid-sized European municipal water authorities closed oversubscribed green bond offerings this week featuring an unusual performance covenant: interest coupons automatically drop by fifteen basis points if acoustic trunk-main sensors reduce non-revenue water losses below 15 percent by 2028.

Aging cast-iron distribution mains across older industrial cities routinely lose a quarter of treated drinking water before it reaches a tap, forcing utilities to pump and chemically treat far more volume than residents consume.
